description: This file defines a template class FactoryType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, implementing a factory pattern for creating and managing objects of a base type identified by an identifier. It includes nested classes for factory instances and an iterator for traversing registered factories.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class implementing a factory pattern for creating and managing objects of type BASEOBJECT, identified by an IDENTIFIER, with internal management of factory instances and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the registered factory instances within FactoryType.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by FactoryType.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory instance identified by the given identifier.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for a specific element type with an initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to an element of type ACTUALELEMENT associated with the given identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the base object associated with the specified identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all registered factory instances.
